title: Inspection Troubles & Treasures | Whiskey Wine Down by Dom McShan w/ Inspector Ruben Salazar
description:
In this Whiskey Wine Down episode we dive deep into the world of home inspections! 🏠🔍 Join us as we sit down with an experienced home inspector who shares invaluable insights, tips, and stories from the field. Whether you're a first-time homebuyer, a homeowner looking to sell, or simply curious about what goes on behind the scenes during a home inspection, this interview is a must-watch. Discover how to spot red flags, differentiate between minor issues and major concerns, and ensure your property is in top shape. Don't miss out – hit that play button and get ready to uncover the secrets of home inspections! 🏡🔎
